title: Add mechanism for arbitrary maintenance step
description:
## Prior art

1. https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-workflows/blob/62ff25a8a59682d2672e739b50ca4a0fbaa81614/.github/workflows/routine.yaml#L124-L127
2. https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-workflows/blob/main/.github/internal/run-local-script/action.yaml

## Where this would be useful

- `learnr` includes internationalization files that need to be rebuilt, currently handled by a PR command. The problem is that PR commands can write back to the PR branch even when it's from a fork, whereas GitHub actions from the `pull_request` event can't. (I can't find any documentation on that specifically other than that GHA can't push to fork branches, but obviously it does for the commands so 🤷 )
